findings.summary: The stale tab accepts the rename (PUT /api/card/71 → 200) with no warning, and the metric comes back out of the trash: the red "This metric is in the trash." banner is gone from the metric page, and "agent2-twotab-v3" is listed again under Our analytics on Browse > Metrics.
